$comment: Portable runtime-admission corpus for .ores-lock.toml. Config snippets are TOML text so every runtime and repository auditor can exercise the same cases without deriving one peer authority from the other.

cases.toml:
schema_version = "ores.lock.config.v1"
default_profile = "local-install"
selected_profile_env = "ORES_LOCK_PROFILE"

[[env]]
key = "ORES_LOCK_PROFILE"
kind = "string"
required = false
secret = false

[[env]]
key = "ORES_LOCK_ROOT"
kind = "path"
required = false
secret = false

[[profiles]]
profile_id = "local-install"
wait = true
wait_timeout_ms = 30000
retry_interval_ms = 50

[profiles.providers]
local_file = true
fiducia = false
pg_advisory = false

[profiles.local_file]
root_env = "ORES_LOCK_ROOT"
require_existing_root = false
